messages:
Olga Ivanov: Heads-up 
 - NebulaWorks (acct NW-664) invoice INV-2026-317 for $21,450 is past due. AP emailed asking to split and disputing a $1,800 charge they claim is duplicate. Can we approve a plan without legal?
Marcus Lee: Quick check 10s
 - No prior payment plan. Invoice 41 days overdue. Ticket #TKT-5483 from CS contains their logs.
Sana Patel: Collections policy: mgrs can approve up to $2,000 credit and payment plans up to 90 days with >=30% initial. So $1,800 credit is within Ops authority if we get logs and a signed agreement.
Ravi - CS: Customer on call now. They propose 30% now, 35% in 30 days, 35% in 60 days. Said they'll send proof of wire for the first installment if we redact internal job ids on the invoice.
Tom (Billing): Proposed terms:
```
- Credit: $1,800 (goodwill) contingent on signed agreement and incident acknowledgement
- Balance after credit: $19,650
- Schedule: 30% ($5,895) due 2025-12-08, 35% ($6,877.50) due 2026-01-07, 35% ($6,877.50) due 2026-02-06
- Waive current late fee if initial payment clears by 2025-12-10
```
I can prepare INV-2026-317-A and send via DocuSign. We should pause auto-suspend 72h while customer signs.
Olga Ivanov: Agree to pause for 72h. Include clause: "credit contingent on executed payment agreement". Also capture that this is one-time goodwill.
Marcus Lee: Engineering, please confirm duplicate billing claim. If eng confirms it's our ingest bug, proceed with credit; otherwise hold credit until dispute resolved.
Sana Patel: Approve the $1,800 credit pending eng validation and signed DocuSign. Add account note: "Conditional payment plan approved; do not suspend until 2026-01-09 if initial payment posts."
Ravi - CS: Sent customer the DocuSign at 1997503600. They viewed at 1997503700 and asked that invoice line items redact job ids. Billing will sanitize.
collections-bot: DocuSign status: sent -> viewed at 1997503700. Dunning timer paused per manual override. Reminder scheduled: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-09.
Tom (Billing): Drafted INV-2026-317-A and redacted job ids. Sent DocuSign with credit memo. Also put ACH/wire instructions inside the secure portal (not pasted here).
Marcus Lee: Eng confirms root cause: retry dedupe missed when request-id field absent for 2 retries on 2025-11-15 (ENG-3261). Recommend credit.
Olga Ivanov: With eng validation, approve the $1,800 credit. Proceed once DocuSign signed and initial payment clears.
Sana Patel: Remember to mark the credit memo "one-time goodwill" and include the remediation acknowledgement. If customer later asks for more, escalate to Legal.
Tom (Billing): I'll monitor payments and post receipts. Set a follow-up for 2025-12-09 to confirm initial payment. If payment doesn't post, we resume suspension and escalate.
collections-bot: Reminder set: verify-initial-payment on 2025-12-09.
Ravi - CS: Customer said they'll wire initial 30% on 2025-12-08 and signed the DocuSign at 1997504800. They sent the wire reference via support ticket.
Tom (Billing): Received wire confirmation at 1997505400 for $5,895. Posted to ledger and cleared hold. Updated INV-2026-317-A as paid for first installment.
Olga Ivanov: Great. Release suspension hold and monitor next installments. Add a note for renewals: "account took one-time credit for ingest dupes in Nov 2025."
Sana Patel: Closing note: if next installment fails, escalate to Legal and Collections. Thanks team :thumbsup:
